title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Deposit Hold, Final Invoice and Contract Closing
content:
**Payments note — how a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental contract is settled and closed.**

Two amounts stand on every contract: the **balance due**, which charges and refunds paid out increase and payments and credits decrease; and the **deposit hold**, the authorization hold on the renter's card, which the hold increases and a release or a capture decreases.

### Rules in force

1. At return the final invoice is computed; the renter pays it, or the hold is captured up to the balance due, and the rest of the hold is released within the class release period (calendar days) of closing.
2. A contract closes only when its balance due is zero.
3. A credit balance, such as one created by a breakdown credit after payment, is refunded to the card.
4. A hold is placed once per contract. Whether a hold already stands on the contract is read from the contract's own entries in the company's records.

### Retired rule

5. At pickup an authorization hold is placed on a card of a type the class accepts: the class credit card figure on a credit card or the class debit card figure on a debit card. — This rule is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis of the authorization hold. The card types accepted and the card figures themselves stand on the class schedule unchanged.

## Settlement illustrations (hypothetical amounts)

| At return | Settlement under rule 1 | Closing under rule 2 |
|---|---|---|
| Balance due 180.00, hold 250.00, the renter pays 180.00 | Nothing is captured; the whole 250.00 hold is released within the release period of closing | Balance due is zero, so the contract may close |
| Balance due 180.00, hold 250.00, the renter does not pay | 180.00 of the hold is captured to the balance; the remaining 70.00 is released within the release period of closing | The capture brings the balance due to zero, so the contract may close |
| Balance due 0.00 after a breakdown credit of 40.00 was given on a contract the renter had already paid, leaving a 40.00 credit balance | The 40.00 credit balance is refunded to the card (rule 3) | — |

A capture taken from the hold is booked on the contract as a payment, which is why it reduces the balance due.

superseded_clauses: At pickup an authorization hold is placed on a card in accepted_deposit_methods: deposit_hold_credit_card_usd on a credit card or deposit_hold_debit_card_usd on a debit card.
